scripts.render: npm run render:raw && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_range tv -movflags +faststart -an "../../Mohalla_Demo.mp4"
scripts.render:raw: remotion render src/index.js MohallaDemo out/raw.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:launch: remotion render src/index.js MohallaLaunch out/launch_raw.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/launch_raw.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_range tv -c:a aac -b:a 192k -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart "../../Mohalla_Launch.mp4"
